title: Compositional latent Mirror factors for unseen combinations
hypothesis: Factorized object/style/domain Mirror latent tables trained on incomplete combinations can reconstruct unseen combinations from one fixed shared neural decoder at lower actual bytes than independent per-combination DeepSDF codes.
physical_object: One fixed shared neural decoder Fθ(x,z), input x∈R², latent z∈R¹⁶, MLP 18→64→64→1; identical frozen weights for every method.
mirror_coordinate: Additive m(o,s,d)=E_object[o]+E_style[s]+E_domain[d], with factor table sizes 8,8,4 and 16 dimensions; store a tuple of three uint8 IDs per logical combination.
logical_multiplicity: 256 object×style×domain combinations realized by one fixed decoder; approximately 80% combinations observed for factor learning and the remainder held out.
controls: independent DeepSDF code vector per combination fitted on support points
native additive object/style/domain latent factorization with same table geometry (exact algebraic alias to Mirror)
oracle full latent code table formed from teacher factor vectors

task.train_split: Deterministic 80/20 combination holdout; every individual factor value appears in training.
task.teacher: Each target latent is the sum of independently sampled object, style and domain vectors; output target is the frozen shared decoder applied to x and that sum.

development.selection_metric: held-out combination query NRMSE, actual decoder+code payload bytes, and inference throughput.

storage.format: compressed NPZ; FP16 decoder/factors/codes plus uint8 combination IDs and metadata
paid_objects: all per-combination IDs or independent latent vectors

compute.include: factor-model training, independent-code fitting, heldout support adaptation, combination lookup, query inference.

success_gate: Both development seeds: zero-shot heldout-combination NRMSE <=0.05, <=0.5x the support-adapted DeepSDF NRMSE, actual payload <=0.80x independent full-code payload, and native additive control output agrees within 1e-6. Passing only qualifies for fresh confirmation.
failure_gate: FAIL if either seed misses quality/bytes or if native additive factorization exactly matches Mirror with no other distinct benefit.
boundaries: The shared decoder is fixed and identical, so this isolates latent factor composition from decoder capacity.
The teacher is additive in latent space; this does not establish arbitrary compositional capacity.
Combination counts alone are not capacity; only heldout function quality and bytes count.
Fresh remains sealed unless both development seeds pass.
